note_ko: 2인 포즈 라이브러리. body는 'is' 뒤에 오는 분사(standing/sitting)로 시작, head에 시선까지 적는다(엔진 시선 문장은 대체됨). 인물 A는 프레임 왼쪽, B는 오른쪽(리저널 노드 기준). 팔다리는 관절 인형처럼 부위별로 한 번씩만 적고, 좌우 대신 'the arm closest to {po}'(상대와 가까운 쪽)로 적어 좌우 혼동을 없앤다. {s}{S}{p}{P}{o}=본인, {pp}=상대의 소유격(his/her), {po}=상대의 목적격(him/her). 기준 문서: docs/2인포즈_작성기준.md

손잡기.desc_ko: 나란히 서서 상대와 가까운 쪽 손을 낮게 맞잡음 (둘 다 서 있고 어깨가 거의 닿는 거리)
손잡기.shared_en: the two stand close enough that their shoulders nearly touch, holding hands low between them

a.body: standing with {p} body angled slightly toward {po}
a.arms: {p} arm closest to {po} hangs low with {p} fingers loosely holding {pp} hand, and {p} other arm rests relaxed at {p} side
a.legs: {p} weight rests on the leg farther from {po}, the other knee slightly bent
a.head: {p} head turns toward the camera

b.body: standing with {p} body angled slightly toward {po}
b.arms: {p} arm closest to {po} hangs low with {p} fingers loosely holding {pp} hand, and {p} other hand rests in {p} pocket
b.legs: {p} feet are planted about shoulder width apart
b.head: {p} gaze rests on the camera

팔짱.desc_ko: 나란히 서서 상대와 가까운 쪽 팔을 상대 팔에 끼움
팔짱.shared_en: the two stand close together arm in arm

a.body: standing upright with {p} body turned slightly toward {po}
a.arms: {p} arm closest to {po} is threaded through {pp} arm at the elbow, {p} hand resting lightly on {pp} forearm, and {p} other arm hangs relaxed at {p} side
a.legs: {p} feet are close together, a half step from {po}
a.head: {p} head turns toward the camera

b.body: standing upright with {p} body turned slightly toward {po}
b.arms: {p} arm closest to {po} is bent at the elbow, holding {pp} arm hooked through it, and {p} other arm hangs relaxed at {p} side
b.legs: {p} feet are about shoulder width apart
b.head: {p} gaze rests on the camera

가벼운 포옹.desc_ko: 마주 보고 서서 서로의 등을 감싸 가볍게 안음 (서로 몸이 닿는 거리)
가벼운 포옹.shared_en: the two stand facing each other in a warm, light hug

a.legs: {p} feet are close together between {pp} feet
a.head: {p} head tilts onto {pp} shoulder and {p} gaze turns toward the camera

b.legs: {p} feet are planted about shoulder width apart
b.head: {p} chin lowers close to {pp} hair and {p} gaze stays on the camera

어깨에 기대기.desc_ko: 나란히 서서 한 사람이 상대의 어깨에 머리를 가볍게 기댐
어깨에 기대기.shared_en: the two stand close side by side, one head resting lightly on the other's shoulder

a.body: standing close beside {po} with {p} body angled slightly toward {po}
a.arms: {p} hands are loosely clasped in front of {p} waist
a.head: {p} head rests lightly on {pp} shoulder and {p} gaze turns toward the camera

b.body: standing close beside {po}, {p} shoulder lifted slightly to support {pp} head
b.legs: {p} feet are about shoulder width apart
b.head: {p} cheek tilts toward {pp} hair and {p} gaze stays on the camera

나란히 앉아 대화.desc_ko: 같은 자리에 나란히 앉아 서로를 향해 몸을 살짝 돌리고 대화함 (접촉 없음, 가까운 거리)
나란히 앉아 대화.shared_en: the two sit side by side, turned slightly toward each other in conversation

a.body: sitting with {p} torso turned slightly toward {po}
a.arms: {p} hand closest to {po} rests on {p} knee while {p} other hand gestures lightly
a.head: {p} head turns toward {po}, {p} attention on the conversation

b.body: sitting with {p} torso turned slightly toward {po}
b.arms: {p} hand closest to {po} rests on {p} thigh while {p} other hand holds {p} knee
b.head: {p} head tilts toward {po}, listening

마주 앉아 대화.desc_ko: 서로를 마주 보고 앉아 이야기함 (각자 몸을 상대 쪽으로 돌림, 접촉 없음)
마주 앉아 대화.shared_en: the two sit facing each other, talking

a.body: sitting upright in three-quarter view, turned toward {po}
a.head: {p} head turns toward {po}, mid-conversation

b.body: sitting upright in three-quarter view, turned toward {po}
b.arms: {p} forearms rest on {p} thighs, {p} hands loosely clasped
b.head: {p} head tilts toward {po}, listening
